project_type: Static single-page apologetics website (client-only SPA). Vite + React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS, data-driven from local JSON.
build_system: Vite 5 with @vitejs/plugin-react. npm (v10.8.2) on Node v20.20.2. No monorepo, no workspaces. Fresh scaffold in an empty workspace at /Users/rfievet/projects/AveJesusRex (NOT a git repo yet; do NOT run git unless the user asks).
test_framework: None required for a static content site. Verification is the TypeScript+Vite build (npm run build runs tsc then vite build) plus an optional curl smoke test on port 5317. If tests are added later, use Vitest + React Testing Library.
test_command: npm run build && npm run typecheck
verification_instructions: 1) npm install. 2) npm run build must succeed (tsc typecheck + vite production build, no errors). 3) npm run typecheck must pass. 4) OPTIONAL smoke test: start `npm run dev` in the background, sleep 2, run `curl -s http://localhost:5317 | grep -i 'ave jesus rex'` to confirm the server responds on port 5317, then STOP the dev server. Never leave a dev or preview server running. Commit nothing.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Vite build output goes to dist/ (gitignored). No checked-in generated/snapshot files.
environment_constraints: Port 5317 is required and must be strict (strictPort: true) so it fails loudly instead of silently moving. Server must bind host '0.0.0.0' so the user's phone on the same wifi can reach it at http://192.168.12.101:5317 (that IP is the dev machine's current LAN address, from the task prompt; vite prints the real Network URL at startup). Do NOT leave any server running after a smoke test. Do NOT run git (no repo, user did not ask to commit).
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md/.kiro steering files exist in this empty workspace. The authoritative requirements are the original user messages (in task.json / workflow) and the plan at .agents/tasks/plan.md: professional + aesthetically pleasing, mobile-excellent, port 5317, phone-accessible, future-proof so new arguments/topics are added by editing data only.
key_patterns: Both research JSON files share the SAME per-argument shape: { id, title, shortClaim, category, strength, primaryReferences:[{citation, translationUsed, text}], explanation } with jesus-is-god.json additionally carrying optional originalLanguage:{language,text,translit,note} (on 16/22 args) and nwtRebuttal (string). jw-critique arguments have NEITHER originalLanguage NOR nwtRebuttal — so both MUST be optional in the TypeScript Argument type. strength is one of 'scriptural' | 'strong' | 'supplementary' and MUST render as a visible colored badge. Each argument's `category` matches an entry in the topic's ordered `categories` (jesus-is-god) or `subCategories` (jw-critique), which drives on-page section grouping. Import the JSON (resolveJsonModule) rather than retyping it, so the research stays the single source of truth; cast to the TopicContent type.
relevant_files: .agents/research/jesus-is-god.json (source data: 22 args, 6 categories, uncertainCitations[7]; top-level: title, subtitle, displayTranslation, displayTranslationNote, divineNameNote, methodologyNote, categories, arguments, uncertainCitations)
.agents/research/jw-critique.json (source data: 22 args, top-level: topic, disclaimer, subCategories[5], arguments)
.agents/tasks/plan.md (full implementation plan with locked design decisions, data model, and research->section mapping)
directory_structure: Target layout: index.html, package.json, tsconfig.json, tsconfig.node.json, vite.config.ts, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, .gitignore at root. src/main.tsx, src/App.tsx, src/index.css, src/vite-env.d.ts. src/data/types.ts, src/data/topics.ts (topic registry incl. coming-soon), src/data/content/*.json (copied research) + *.ts (typed re-exports). src/components/ (StrengthBadge, ArgumentCard, ReferenceBlock, OriginalLanguageBlock, Callout, SectionHeader, NavBar, Layout). src/pages/ (Home, TopicPage, NotFound). README.md at root. The research lives in .agents/research/ and task artifacts in .agents/tasks/ (both OUTSIDE src, never bundled).
